data.summary: The Google reviews show some authentic signals like specific names and project details, but the complete lack of any critical feedback, the low volume, and the uniformly effusive tone across all reviews are significant red flags. The pattern is more consistent with solicited or incentivized reviews than an organic customer base.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Multiple reviews use similar generic, effusive language
Low total review count (13) for a contractor
Several reviews posted around the same time period (a year ago)
Lack of specific negative details or minor issues mentioned
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific employee names (Ivan, Sergei, Paul, Volodymir, Oleg, Fima, Victor, Alex, Tatyana)
A few reviews mention specific project types (lanai, gable peak)
Varied reviewer names and some stylistic differences
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only one platform (Google) has reviews. No other platforms have ratings to compare.
